text: Life at the outpost remained shadowed by the presence of a lingering grizzly bear. Amidst the daily routines—Lidia tending to an animal pen and hauling stockpiles of steel and silver from the debris of a downed spacecraft—tensions frayed. Overwhelmed by the wretched conditions of their makeshift barracks, Dillon suffered a psychological break, wandering the camp in a daze while staring vacantly into the distance for targets. Meanwhile, Lidia had fully recovered from her wounds, though her focus on local wildlife proved imperfect after she missed a passing tortoise.
